cohort: 2039 women at one private hospital in Sydney, Australia
finding: The incidence of adverse outcomes was low across all groups, with significant differences observed only for postpartum hemorrhage (lower in pERCB) and special care nursery admission (higher in pVBAC + EMCB).
mod_finding: Women who planned a VBAC had a higher likelihood of special care nursery admission if they had an emergency cesarean compared to those who had a successful VBAC.
